coverage: Wusheng: real manual reload rejects the retired source; copied current records cannot choose a source; a source retired by rebuilding cannot clear the selected source or target; cancellation withdraws its published source; current source toggle off/on and exact converted Slash payment remain valid.

Judgment material: capture a real rendered regional-card Button command and parameter; reject it after manual reload and after selection rebuild; reject a copied current record; current regional selection toggles normally; CancelAction withdraws both regional parameters and conversion sources; fresh current choices commit the exact Lightning material as Slash with Judgment-to-Processing payment and one native completion.

Foreign public pile: capture a rendered cost Button command and parameter; its retired parameter cannot toggle off the currently selected cost; a copied current record cannot change the draft; a pre-tutorial parameter cannot change restored costs or targets. Fresh current parameters still toggle, choose two costs and targets, pay the exact foreign owner once, preserve the actor hand, and cold replay.

Each rejected input is checked immediately for draft stability to avoid two toggles masking each other. Wusheng also freezes its three private client draft fields; new core comparisons use CreateSnapshot(0).
